snippet.title: That's My Village! - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
That's My Village! - A roguelite village builder. Assign every job, keep morale from collapsing, and hold the line when fire, plague and monster waves arrive. Win or lose, your Legacy carries into the next run.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4225070/Thats_My_Village/
